  "workers": "LIST (optional - An array of worker IDs.)",

  "threshold": "NUMBER (optional - For trigger 1, the time threshold in seconds; for trigger 2, the distance threshold in meters.)",
  "capacity": "NUMBER (optional - The maximum number of units this worker can carry, for route optimization purposes.)",
  "vehicle": "JSON (optional - The worker\u2019s vehicle; providing no vehicle details is equivalent to the worker being on foot.)",
  "filter": "LIST (optional -  An array of fields to return, if all are not desired. For example, name, location.)",
